properties.notes: Cleared site within existing urban area, previously occupied by sheltered housing scheme, but site now vacant following demolition in 2016. Offers opportunity for urban infill scheme within Ashington. The replacement of the former care home with more suitable dwellings, better meeting current housing need, has now been identified as part of a process of renewal and regeneration of social housing stock. An application for construction of 8 new dwellings has now been secured (19/02032/FUL). Development now underway and forecast for completion within the next 5 years.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
